projects.title: Library Test Coverage Capstone
bullets: Wrote unit tests for utility functions in small open-source data-cleaning libraries using Python and pytest as part of a supervised undergraduate capstone team.
Documented test failures and fixes and measured branch coverage for the libraries within the capstone project.

research.title: Public News Text Classification
bullets: Implemented a bag-of-words classifier for short public news-topic documents using Python and scikit-learn as a supervised student research assistant.
Documented training and test splits for the public news-topic text used in the supervised classification work.
